about: Problems a victim can run into with the justice process, and the steps and legal basis a counsellor can act on. Counsellor-facing guidance, not legal advice: confirm with the Special Public Prosecutor or legal aid before acting.
caveat: Statutes are cited from the texts listed in `sources`. BNSS 2023 replaced the CrPC from 1 July 2024 (s.173 BNSS = old s.154 CrPC, s.175 BNSS = old s.156). Hindi victim labels are drafts that need a native reviewer.

fir_refused.title: Police refused or delayed the FIR

victim_label.en: The police would not register my complaint (FIR)
victim_label.hi: पुलिस ने मेरी शिकायत (FIR) दर्ज नहीं की

steps.text: Write down the date, police station, and the name or rank of the officer, and what was said.
Send the complaint in writing, by post, to the Superintendent of Police. The SP must investigate or direct an investigation.
If the SP does not act, apply to the Magistrate with a copy of the SP complaint and an affidavit.
Tell the police in writing that no preliminary enquiry is needed before an FIR under the Act.
Wilfully not registering the FIR is a punishable neglect of duty (6 months to 1 year) for a public servant who is not SC/ST; the Special Court takes cognizance.
Log the refusal with the National Helpline Against Atrocities, 14566.

fir_copy.title: No copy of the FIR given

victim_label.en: I was not given a copy of my FIR
victim_label.hi: मुझे FIR की कॉपी नहीं मिली

steps.text: Ask the police station for the copy in writing; it has to be given to the informant forthwith, free.
If refused, write to the Superintendent of Police and note it as neglect of duty.

victim_label.en: Nothing is happening with the investigation
victim_label.hi: जाँच में कुछ नहीं हो रहा

steps.text: Check how long it has been since the FIR: the charge sheet is due in the Special Court within 60 days, and a delay has to be explained in writing.
Write to the Superintendent of Police asking for the status and the reason for delay.
Bring the dereliction to the Special Court, which takes cognizance and can direct penal proceedings.

victim_label.en: Someone threatened me or my family
victim_label.hi: किसी ने मुझे या मेरे परिवार को धमकी दी

steps.text: Check safety first. If there is danger right now, call 112.
The State has a duty to protect victims, their dependents and witnesses from intimidation, coercion, inducement, violence or threats. Ask the SP and the Special Court for protection.
Apply under the Witness Protection Scheme, 2018: category A if the threat is to life, B to safety, reputation or property, C for harassment or intimidation.
steps.basis: Witness Protection Scheme 2018; Mahender Chawla v. Union of India (2018)

steps.text: A fresh threat is a fresh incident: help register a new complaint and add it to the case record.

victim_label.en: People are pressuring me to settle or take back the case
victim_label.hi: मुझ पर समझौता करने या केस वापस लेने का दबाव है

steps.text: Coercion and inducement to withdraw are what s.15A(1) protection covers. Ask the SP and the Special Court for protection.
Inform the Special Public Prosecutor so the pressure is on the court record.
If it continues, apply under the Witness Protection Scheme, 2018.

no_hearing_notice.title: Not told about a court date or bail hearing

victim_label.en: I was not told about a court date
victim_label.hi: मुझे अदालत की तारीख के बारे में नहीं बताया गया

steps.text: The victim has a right to reasonable, accurate and timely notice of every court proceeding, including bail; the Special Public Prosecutor or the State must inform them.
They are entitled to be heard at any bail, discharge, release, parole, conviction or sentence proceeding.
The Supreme Court has held this notice mandatory; an order passed without it can be challenged.
Add the hearing in SAHAAS with the notice box unticked so the s.15A watchdog tracks it, and write to the Special Public Prosecutor.

victim_label.en: The support money I am owed has not come
victim_label.hi: मुझे मिलने वाली सहायता राशि नहीं आई

steps.text: Check which stage is due from Annexure-I (the split differs by offence) and add it in the Relief tab.
Follow up with the District Magistrate / District Social Welfare Officer who sanctions the payment.

victim_label.en: I paid for travel to court or police myself
victim_label.hi: अदालत या थाने जाने का किराया मुझे खुद देना पड़ा

steps.text: Victims, dependents and witnesses are paid travel and maintenance for going to investigation and trial; women, minors, people over 60 and people with 40%+ disability are entitled to an attendant, who is paid too.
Add a TAME entitlement in the Relief tab so it is tracked until paid.

victim_label.en: My court dates keep getting pushed
victim_label.hi: मेरी अदालत की तारीख बार-बार बढ़ रही है

steps.text: The trial should, as far as possible, finish within two months of the charge sheet.
Ask the Special Public Prosecutor to press for the case to be heard without further adjournment.
Log each adjournment as a case date so the adjournment alert and the distress forecast see them.

no_lawyer.title: No lawyer, or the prosecutor is not engaging

victim_label.en: I don't have a lawyer, or the lawyer isn't helping
victim_label.hi: मेरे पास वकील नहीं है, या वकील मदद नहीं कर रहे

steps.text: The District Magistrate may engage an eminent senior advocate, including one the victim chooses, to conduct the case.
The victim has a right to help from NGOs, social workers or advocates.
Free legal aid: NALSA helpline 15100, or the District Legal Services Authority.

victim_label.en: I am still being harassed or kept out (boycott)
victim_label.hi: मुझे अब भी परेशान किया जा रहा है या बहिष्कार हो रहा है

steps.text: Imposing or threatening a social or economic boycott is itself an offence; help register a fresh complaint.
Ask for protection against continued intimidation.

victim_label.hi: अधिकारियों ने मेरे साथ बुरा व्यवहार किया

steps.text: A victim must be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, with regard to age, gender, education or poverty.
Help write a complaint to the officer's superior (SP for police, the District Magistrate otherwise).

victim_label.hi: मेरे मामले से जुड़ी कोई और बात

steps.text: Call to understand the problem, then re-file it under the right category.
